citation.authors: Nam S, Jeon S, Ordway M, Mazure C et al

cited_by.title: Coping with anxiety day to day

record.design: Pilot randomised trial of online mindfulness-based therapy for insomnia against lifestyle health education, 10 weeks
record.finding: Insomnia improved in both groups; anxiety and depression symptoms improved significantly only in the mindfulness group. Nearly all attended 6 to 8 of 8 sessions. The authors call it feasible and acceptable.
record.note: A pilot of 30 women with insomnia, not a trial of anxiety.
